component.name: gitext-core
component.summary: Browse history, stage changes and manage branches in Git repositories

description.p: gitext-core is a fast, native Git GUI for Linux, Windows and macOS. It rebuilds the GitExtensions experience on modern .NET and Avalonia: a commit graph that makes tangled histories readable, a UI that maps onto how Git actually works, and speed that stays out of your way.

It drives the real git command line rather than a reimplementation of it, so your hooks, aliases, credential helpers and configuration all behave exactly as they do in a terminal. Every operation shows the underlying command it ran.

ul.li: Read a commit graph of hundreds of thousands of commits without waiting
Stage and unstage by file, hunk or individual line
Commit, branch, merge, rebase (including interactive), cherry-pick and revert
Fetch, pull and push, with force-with-lease anchored to what you actually saw
Resolve conflicts, manage stashes, browse the reflog, blame and file history
Light and dark themes, a colour-blind-safe graph palette, and reassignable shortcuts

description.p: gitext-core collects no telemetry of any kind.
This is a clean-room reimplementation inspired by GitExtensions. It is not a port of it and is not affiliated with the GitExtensions project.
